claim: Open-window detector trips on model bias and freezes every learner: 15-19 % of intervals at delivery 0.4, 0 at 1.0
v1_number: vent_tripped_share fix1.00: P0 g0.40 0.187, P1 g0.40 0.172 (none arm 0.181); g0.60 0.000 (P1 none 0.025); g1.00 0.000 on all 6 plants -- matches 15-19 %
v2_number: learner_v2.py --two-zone, PRODUCTION _learning_frozen: share of intervals frozen 'ventilation' = 0.984 / 0.983 at delivery 0.4 (2 seeds), learner stalls at UA bias +0.19 / +0.18; the finder's patched method on the same trajectory gives 0.057 / 0.060 with UA bias +0.55. Threshold on this house: 0 at delivery >= 0.5, 0.183 at 0.45
v2_metric: share of 15-min intervals after which production coordinator._learning_frozen(indoor, outdoor) == 'ventilation'
null_control: delivery 1.0, exact prior: 0.000 (both seeds, both houses); UA truth 1.3x and 1.6x the prior at delivery 1.0: 0.000 (learner absorbs before the CUSUM)
attacks: finder's harness patches _learning_frozen to None, so learners keep absorbing the bias and the CUSUM releases -> it UNDER-states production; with the real freeze the latch is near-permanent (heat-loss learner feeds the CUSUM only in vent_only mode, release_if_starved never fires while residuals flow) -- mechanism confirmed in coordinator.py (vent_only path, _learning_frozen 'ventilation'). Reach narrowed: a delivery shortfall is a model bias only where the replay uses commanded power (no power entity: _interval_space_power returns commanded); metered installs replay measured power (v4.0.5). Trigger needs >= ~55 % heat deficit on my house; UA prior errors up to 1.6x and delivery >= 0.5 never trip. Single-zone (heat via slab, true slab handed in) never trips -- a harness limitation, not a refutation
class: bug (detector conflates persistent model bias with an open window; self-latching freeze)
notes: Production effect is stronger than claimed (98 % vs 15-19 %) but the trigger is narrower than 'model bias' in general: only large cold-side bias on unmetered installs. 'High' would need the owner-install figure the commit cites, which I did not use. Reconstructed from intake JSON.
